pages.en:
…Perhaps everything Shirou Emiya did afterward was done for the sole purpose of proving those words wrong.

There need not be sacrifices.

If you try—if you give everything you have—then no one has to be hurt.

My old man—Kiritsugu—must have yearned for that all his life too.

And so—

…Since that time, Emiya Shirou’s whole life may have been focused on overturning those words.
There’s no need for sacrifices.
Nobody will get hurt if you work hard and do your best.
My father should have yearned for that as well.
So…

pages.en:
There is no world in which no one is hurt,

and no happiness that comes without hurting someone.

No utopia so convenient exists anywhere upon this earth.

The Hero of Justice Shirou Emiya seeks to become is, by that fact alone, a hypocrite.

“…Then why do you mean to follow us? If you seek to settle matters with me, I have no objection to doing so here.”

“No, I'll pass on that too. I've got no wish to make an enemy of your Master. What I'd rather do is sell her a favor. I'm coming along to put her in my debt.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Then why are you going to come with us? If you want to settle the match with me, I can do it right here.”
“No, I’ll pass on that. I have no intention of fighting against your Master. Rather, I want to sell her some favors. I want her to be in debt to me.”

“Hm… that is true, but still…”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That should be all right. He’s twisted, but he won’t lie. First of all, he’s not the sneaky type. He’d come fight us straight on before he would try to trick us.”
“Hm… That is true, but…”

pages.mirrorMoon: “Well, I’ll turn him down if you don’t want to. But he’ll follow us even if we let him be. So isn’t it easier for us to have him near us where we can keep watch?”

“Hm—you have grown remarkably persuasive in only a few days, Shirou.”

“A lot has happened.

“Anyway, there it is, Lancer. We won't interfere with you, and you won't interfere with us. If you can agree to that, let's go together.”

“Hmyou are getting better at making excuses, Shirou.”
“Well, a lot has happened.
Well, that’s it, Lancer. We won’t concern ourselves with you, and you don’t bother us. Let’s go together if that’s fine with you.”

I guess Saber doesn’t get along well with Lancer.
But I never thought Saber would get angry like Tohsaka.
